content:
In today's meeting we talked about labels we use on GitHub for issues and pull requests that have to do with internationalization.

The backend already had them but I just created labels for the frontend and previewers as well:

  • backend issues and pull requests - "Feature: Internationalization"
  • frontend issues and pull requests  - "SPA: Internationalization"
  • previewers issues and pull requests - "internationalization"
@Amber Leahey since you mentioned Data Explorer, please let me know if you create a label at https://github.com/scholarsportal/Dataverse-Data-Explorer/labels
